verdict.rationale: Skyvern publishes its source in a public GitHub repo (Skyvern-AI/skyvern), and its llms.txt describes it as an open-source platform. An independent community comment confirms the code is AGPL-3.0 licensed, an OSI-approved open license, though copyleft terms may deter some companies. The self-hosted docs add that it can run entirely on your own infrastructure. Missing for 10: a first-party statement or LICENSE file naming the license (it is confirmed only by a community comment), and evidence about how complete the open repo is versus the cloud offering.
